claims.claim: The bike is just 3 months old.
claims.evidence: Photos show the motorcycle but cannot reveal age or year of manufacture.

claims.claim: The bike is in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the exterior only; mechanical condition is not shown.
Purchase history and age are not shown in photos; this also conflicts with the 3-month claim.
Operation of gears and brakes is not shown.
Close-up condition of the frame and exhaust is not shown.
Originality of parts cannot be determined from photos.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run.
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, idling, and being revved.
Photo of the VIN/chassis number or registration document showing the year.

risks.risk: Ownership documents or registration are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of original registration papers and proof of ownership.

risks.risk: Brakes, tires, chain, or battery need replacement.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of brakes, tires, chain, and battery terminals.

risks.risk: Accident or repair history is hidden.
risks.proof: Seller disclosure plus close-up photos of frame, forks, and bodywork for damage.
Clear photo of brand and model badges or the VIN plate.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Photo of the VIN/chassis number and brand/model badges.
Photo of ownership documents and registration.
Close-up photos of brakes, tires, chain, and battery.
Written disclosure of any accident or repair history.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a motorcycle, so a worst-case price is possible; all seller claims about age, condition, and originality cannot be verified from the photos.
